summary: Narrow, steep residential street lined with homes within 10 m; nowhere usable.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign mapped

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the whole stretch, most 4-12 m from the kerb, with pools and decks facing the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, but cars park tight along it and the lane is narrow.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with local traffic only.
drivers.convention: A No Stopping Any Time sign is mapped at 9 m from the kerb line; only a few residents' cars park here.

flags: Steep: 7.5% mean, up to 18% in places
Dwellings within 10 m along the whole stretch
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy and house shade; mostly open at the downhill end.
